scope: Distribution-rights and provenance inventory for retained visual assets. This gate does not require Clear branding or artwork to be licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.

ownerStatement.summary: The owner explicitly approved grouped distribution rights for all retained assets on 2026-09-25, confirmed authorship/ownership or necessary rights over inputs, and kept Clear branding outside GPL.

Twenty-two individually listed brand/documentation files retain REMOVE dispositions and are confirmed absent. The six owner-designed download buttons were reclassified into a separate README-only authorization group on 2026-10-02.

Owner-marked obsolete legacy icon/art families were removed. The configured Windows bundle and Store staging continue to use the separate, unmarked Clear icon files; active UI preview fallbacks now use an existing Clear brand asset.

The owner identified these purple platform logos as obsolete artwork from early app versions and said they are not part of the current app. Tauri bundle configuration and the MSIX staging script do not consume them.

The project owner supplied the original navbar/theme PNG artwork and directly authorized adapting and distributing these eight lossless mask assets in the v1.0.0 interface on 2026-09-30. The source images remain outside the application bundle; the masks remove baked backgrounds and retain only the white glyph and designated recolorable cyan regions.
